name: Modmail Logviewer
description: A simple webserver to view Modmail logs.

CONNECTION_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI that contains your Modmail logs.

USE_ATTACHMENT_PROXY.description: Whether if the logviewer should use a proxy to view attachments. If set to 'no', attachments will expire after 1 day. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.

SAVE_ATTACHMENTS.description: Whether to archive attachments to MongoDB GridFS. Set to 'yes' to enable.

ARCHIVE_INTERVAL.description: How often (in seconds) to scan for unarchived attachments. Default: 600

ARCHIVE_RETENTION.description: How long to keep archived attachments. Options: 1w, 1month, 1y, forever. Default: forever

ARCHIVE_COMPRESS_IMAGES.description: Compress images to JPEG before storing to save space. Default: yes

ARCHIVE_IMAGE_QUALITY.description: JPEG quality (1-100). Lower = smaller files. Default: 65
